subject: Bulk Inquiry – Rice Protein Concentrate for Import to Indonesia
text:
Dear Company,

My name is Budi, and I represent PT CONTOH NUSANTARA, a leading
distribution company based in Indonesia. We are currently seeking a
reliable supplier for bulk quantities of Rice protein concentrate and
are interested in placing an initial trial order before moving forward
with larger ongoing purchases.

Could you kindly confirm if you have prior experience shipping to
Indonesia? Your confirmation, along with any product specifications or
pricing details, would be greatly appreciated.

Kind regards,

Budi Hartono
Business Development Manager
PT CONTOH NUSANTARA
Jakarta, Indonesia
